# Pipa

Pipa is a multilingual, voice-first learning companion for children. It supports playful speech and mathematics practice, with private progress insights and recommendations for parents.

## Canonical site

- https://www.hellopipa.world/

## Product areas

- Child experience: hands-free conversational learning and practice
- Parent nest: progress, recommendations, account, and subscription management
- Privacy and safety: https://www.hellopipa.world/privacy
- Terms: https://www.hellopipa.world/terms
